posts.text:
Appeals court rejects fair use defence in first AI-training copyright ruling
https://theaipost.net/story/find-ross-thomson-reuters-appeal/

Google DeepMind open-sources SynthID Bio to watermark AI-designed proteins

DeepMind says its Nature paper shows watermarks for protein sequences and AlphaFold 3 structures, and the detection code and validation data are now on GitHub.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-synthid-bio/

Ideogram 4.5 edits images repeatedly without drift, company says

Ideogram says its new edit model avoids the artifacts that build up over repeated edits, and fal says 94 to 99 percent of untouched pixels survive ten edits.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-ideogram-4-5/

FTC opens probe of Anthropic, OpenAI and METR, New York Post reports

The agency is drafting civil investigative demands to compel AI executives to testify about their products, the Post reported, citing sources.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-ftc-ai-labs-probe/

OpenAI stays out of Nvidia's agent safety platform, TechCrunch reports

More than 100 companies back Nvidia's Open Agent Safety Platform, but OpenAI, Amazon, Google and Apple are absent, and OpenAI says it is working with Nvidia privately.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-nvidia-oasp/

Instagram adds an AI assistant to Edits that reads your video metrics

Meta says the chatbot in its CapCut rival analyses follows, views, retention, likes and shares, and leaves creative calls to the creator. Basic use is included.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-instagram-edits-ai-assistant/

DoorDash opens a waitlist for ordering food by text in Apple Messages

DoorDash says its new AI agent builds carts, remembers "skip cilantro" and checks out inside an Apple Messages thread, with no app. US users can join a waitlist at doordash.com/text.

https://theaipost.net/story/cf013329c/

OpenAI research chief says monitors now run during training

Mark Chen tells MIT Technology Review OpenAI moved 5 to 10 percent of its compute to safety monitoring and flagged a new agent hack in 15 minutes. A nonprofit has sued over the breach.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-chen-hack-fallout/

Pi coding agent adds MCP to its core after saying no to it
https://theaipost.net/story/find-pi-dev-mcp-core/

Bloomberg says Apple's HomePad home hub launches October 13

Bloomberg reports Apple's 6-inch home display, styled after the iMac G4, arrives October 13 with a new HomePod mini and an Apple TV 4K with Siri AI, under CEO John Ternus.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-apple-homepad-oct-13/

Altman says OpenAI will not list until it can make confident safety claims
https://theaipost.net/story/find-altman-ipo-safety/

Meta tells tax authorities its AI data centers are experiments, NYT reports
https://theaipost.net/story/find-meta-tax-experimental/

Mathematicians advise OpenAI to release AI proofs with prompts and costs
https://theaipost.net/story/find-agmai-math-release/

China's ModelScope and MoArk race to replace Hugging Face at home
https://theaipost.net/story/find-modelscope-moark-rest-of-world/

Ollama adds local decision models, starting with a 9B Nimble

`ollama pull nimble` gets a 9-billion-parameter Apache-2.0 model that answers up to 64 questions about a text, with odds for each answer. Its maker claims under 100ms on a MacBook Pro.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-ollama-nimble-decision-models/

DeepSeek open-sources its kernel libraries for Huawei's Ascend chips

DeepSeek says every TileLang operator used in training its V4 models now has an Ascend version. FlashMLA's README claims 95% of the Ascend 950's peak on prefill.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-deepseek-ascend-kernels/

Artificial Analysis open-sources a tool to time AI agents on your own laptop
https://theaipost.net/story/find-aa-agentperf-local/
